[P2] Approach: exercise the missing-log-group branch

The new handler's import-time guard remains untested. Deleting its `if not log_group_name` and associated raise leaves these source assertions passing because other `raise RuntimeError` statements remain. The cloud template always supplies the environment variable, so enabling that scenario does not cover the missing-value behavior either. This violates rule 4, “Every branch has a test that fails without it,” and allows the promised configuration failure to regress undetected. Please return to the design phase under rule 8, step 6, and choose validation based on observable behavior.
